verdict.rationale: Runpod documents creating, starting, stopping, and terminating Pods through the CLI (runpodctl), and through the GraphQL API with cURL examples. A REST API v1 covers all compute resources. Billing is per second for compute and storage, so cost follows actual usage. Missing for 10: an explicit restart operation, documentation of what a stopped Pod still costs (storage is also billed per second), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the lifecycle API.
